decisions.statement: A message already on disk is never fetched again.
Messages are fetched eight at a time rather than one by one or every message at once.
Mail is reached by calling the message functions rather than by running a command.
A fault at Gmail rises to the caller rather than being caught here.
A cached message no longer listed is not returned.
The cache folder is handed in by the caller rather than settled here.

definition: the Amazon mail this harness reads, fetched once and kept on disk
